# scripts/Visual/AdrenalineView.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/AdrenalineView.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Combat screen effects: adrenaline heartbeat, impact jolt, directional hurt, and low-health desaturation.
Drawn below Retro (layer 4) and the HUD (layer 5); show_state() and set_health() are frame inputs.

Base: `CanvasLayer`. Registered class: `none`.
